Measured: deleting 60 of 561 md5s from one fold's bacterial run moved the primary delta -0.2610 -> -0.2347 with every other control still passing. A domain whose run was never LAUNCHED is treated differently PER CELL -- those cells are unscoreable_method_not_run for every arm, so the denominators stay equal -- but in the gated modes it is now a leg-6/7 FAILURE rather than a note, because equal denominators over a 10.4%-smaller population behind a headline that never mentions Archaea is precisely the laundering this control exists to stop (pass --expect-domains to declare a deliberately narrower scope, SPEC D22). A planned fold absent from BOTH methods is caught by leg 5: both denominators shrink equally, so legs 1-4 are silent while the headline covers 2 of 3 folds. Legs 6-7 invert the question, because legs 1-5 all ask it of the runs that happen to be ON DISK: a killed (fold, domain) job whose refs/ survives (-30% of the population at EXIT 0), a stale retry directory merged in silently (primary delta -0.2610 -> -0.0345 for PICRUSt2, -0.2039 for prFBA), a never-launched archaeal arm (-10.4%, delta -0.2443 against a frozen SESOI of 0.02), a fold launched with a shorter --select-modes (that arm at n=1258 vs 1922) and a whole lost density tier are all one defect -- the scored inventory is not the planned one -- and set equality against the DERIVED plan catches them by construction rather than by whichever symptom each happens to leave behind
